title: Self- or Rival-Revelation? Dynamic Information Design in Sequential Competition
affiliations: , University of Illinois, Yale University, Department of Economics and Tianjin University

detail.title: Self- or Rival-Revelation? Dynamic Information Design in Sequential Competition
detail.abstract: In uncertain environments, consumers seek and interpret information to reduce ambiguity and guide their choices and purchase decisions. In this paper, we study how firms strategically design information about either themselves or their rivals to influence consumer purchase decisions in dynamic competition. We construct a dynamic Bayesian persuasion model in which a leader firm and a follower firm sequentially design and send their information to consumers to strategically shape consumers' beliefs on the two firms' product match. Our analysis shows that, strikingly, the leader firm may choose to "serve" the competing rival firm with a high risk gambler strategy of fully providing the rival information to consumers, especially when consumers have moderate prior beliefs for the leader firm. In addition, when consumers have relatively high prior beliefs for the leader firm, the leader firm may surprisingly choose a downward twisted self-revelation strategy, intentionally disseminating unfavorable signals about itself despite favorable product match to manipulate consumer purchase. Finally, we show that an increase in competition may intensify information manipulation.

title: Spatial Disparities and Policy Effectiveness in Azerbaijan's Regional Development
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Spatial Disparities and Policy Effectiveness in Azerbaijan's Regional Development
detail.abstract: This study assesses the design, implementation, and outcomes of the State Program for the SocioEconomic Development of the Regions of the Republic of Azerbaijan, the country's most comprehensive long-term development initiative spanning 2004-2023. Drawing on official statistical data and fiscal records, the paper evaluates four consecutive program cycles and complementary urban development schemes to determine their effectiveness in promoting balanced regional growth, reducing spatial disparities, and fostering economic diversification. Findings reveal that despite cumulative investments of approximately 92.2 billion Azerbaijani manats, regional inequality has not diminished. Economic activity remains overwhelmingly concentrated in the Baku-Absheron area, which generates over 80 percent of GDP while covering just 2.5 percent of the country's territory. The analysis demonstrates that regional policy outcomes have closely followed the cyclical pattern of hydrocarbon revenues, with the bulk of financing disbursed during oil-boom periods. The study also identifies the persistent procyclical character of public expenditure, weak institutional decentralization, and limited privatesector engagement as key constraints undermining the program's developmental impact. The paper concludes that Azerbaijan's regional development strategy has achieved partial infrastructural improvements but failed to alter the highly centralized spatial structure of its economy. Future policies should prioritize institutional reforms, fiscal diversification, and enhanced regional autonomy to ensure inclusive, sustainable, and post-oil development.

title: Signaling Innovation Value to a Counterfeit Manufacturer in Online Platform Competition: Innovative Manufacturer’s Certification Strategy Choice
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Signaling Innovation Value to a Counterfeit Manufacturer in Online Platform Competition: Innovative Manufacturer’s Certification Strategy Choice
detail.abstract: This paper examines a supply chain (SC) where an innovative manufacturer that designs and produces original products and a counterfeit manufacturer that learns spillover innovative knowledge and produces pirated products, engaging in price competition on an online shopping platform. The former possesses private innovative value information and can verify its products’ originality by participating in the platform’s originality certification (POC). Under information asymmetry, based on whether POC participates or not, we identify the conditions for six signaling game equilibria. The results show that: (i) A high enough innovation value enables innovative manufacturers to separate naturally; as the innovation value decreases, both costly separating equilibrium and pooling equilibrium coexist; when the innovation value is low enough, only pooling equilibrium exists. (ii) Innovation spillover navigates innovative manufacturers to pooling, while POC navigates them to separate naturally; when the innovation value is located in a relatively middle region, the participation of POC can eliminate the signaling cost. (iii) Participating in POC does not always harm the counterfeit manufacturer; within a certain range, the participation in POC can help both manufacturers achieve a win-win situation, and this requires the innovative manufacturer to monitor the certification fee and make reasonable equilibrium choices based on its innovation value.

title: Agricultural Policy, Program Underperformance, and Food Security in Azerbaijan: Structural Constraints in a Post-Oil Economy
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Agricultural Policy, Program Underperformance, and Food Security in Azerbaijan: Structural Constraints in a Post-Oil Economy
detail.abstract: This article examines the structural challenges facing Azerbaijan's agrarian sector and their implications for food security in the context of a hydrocarbon-dependent, post-oil economy. Drawing on official statistics from the State Statistical Committee and program documents from the Ministry of Agriculture, the study evaluates the outcomes of major state programs in cotton, tobacco, rice, tea, sericulture, viticulture, and sugar beet production over the period 2012-2024. The analysis reveals substantial underperformance relative to planned targets, with implementation rates for key programs ranging from only 3.9 percent in sericulture to 61.4 percent in cotton. These shortfalls reflect persistent weaknesses in planning, inter-agency coordination, monitoring and evaluation, and private-sector participation. Complementing the program assessment, the article analyzes food self-sufficiency ratios for 2020-2024 across livestock, crop, and processed food categories. The findings demonstrate a dual structure: while Azerbaijan achieves high and often surplus production in horticultural and export-oriented commodities (e.g., vegetables, fruits, nuts, and pomegranates), self-sufficiency in strategic staples such as wheat, grains, rice, and vegetable oils remains low and volatile. Livestock and processed food segments exhibit moderate but stagnant self-sufficiency, constrained by technological gaps, import-dependent inputs, and limited value-chain integration. Overall, the evidence indicates that state-led expansion strategies have not translated into broadbased productivity gains, robust food security, or resilient rural development. The article concludes that a shift from politically driven, target-based interventions toward a coherent, market-oriented, and evidence-based policy framework is essential if agriculture is to become a dynamic driver of non-oil diversification and long-term food security in Azerbaijan.

title:
Beyond Borders: How Economic Shocks Propagate Through Space and Networks
—Theory and Evidence from U.S. Minimum Wage Policy
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title:
Beyond Borders: How Economic Shocks Propagate Through Space and Networks
—Theory and Evidence from U.S. Minimum Wage Policy
detail.abstract:
This paper develops a unified theoretical and empirical framework for analyzing treatment effects that propagate through both spatial proximity and network connections. Building on the continuous functional approach in \citet{kikuchi2024dynamical} and the Navier-Stokes foundation in \citet{kikuchi2024navier}, I introduce network channels as continuous internal degrees of freedom, deriving both spatial diffusion and network contagion from common first principles rooted in conservation laws and stochastic processes. The framework resolves three fundamental challenges in modern econometrics: how spatial and network effects interact (the mixed effect), how treatment effects evolve in general equilibrium, and how network structure affects system fragility.

I show that the mixed spatial-network effect emerges naturally at second order in perturbation theory, creating synergistic amplification when geographic proximity and network similarity align. The theoretical analysis yields three main contributions. First, I derive explicit expressions for the mixed effect functional, showing it equals the mutual information between spatial and network coordinates—a purely information-theoretic measure with no free parameters. Second, I extend the analysis to general equilibrium, proving that endogenous price and employment adjustments amplify partial equilibrium estimates by factors between 1.8 and 2.5 depending on market structure. Third, I connect network structure to system fragility through entropy production rates, providing operational measures of how consolidation affects shock dissipation speeds and cascade probabilities.

The empirical application uses county-level wage data (2018-2023) to analyze minimum wage spillovers across 3,142 U.S. counties and 274 industry classifications. Four main findings emerge. First, the mixed spatial-network effect accounts for 40 percent of total treatment propagation, with point estimate 0.043 (s.e. 0.008), statistically significant and economically large. This implies retail workers in Nevada counties near the California border experience wage increases 43 percent larger than the sum of pure spatial spillover (from proximity alone) and pure network effect (from industry connections) would predict. Second, spatial decay parameters increase from 0.01 per mile for pure geographic spillovers to 0.02 when network effects are included, demonstrating that networks concentrate rather than disperse spatial impacts. Third, general equilibrium amplification factors range from 1.8 (dispersed markets) to 2.5 (concentrated markets), implying substantial bias in partial equilibrium policy evaluation. Fourth, entropy-based fragility measures predict out-of-sample shock propagation with $R^2 = 0.67$, outperforming standard network centrality metrics ($R^2 = 0.43$).

These findings have direct policy implications. Minimum wage policies should account for network amplification: optimal state-level minimum wages are 15-20 percent lower when accounting for general equilibrium feedbacks through supply chains and labor mobility networks. Financial regulation should monitor entropy production rates as early warning indicators: systems approaching critical fragility thresholds (entropy production declining by more than 30 percent) require preemptive intervention before cascades materialize. Regional development policies should leverage spatial-network synergies: infrastructure investments yield highest returns in regions with strong geographic clustering and dense economic networks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一的理论和实证框架，用于分析通过空间邻近性和网络连接传播的处理效应。该框架解决了现代计量经济学的三个基本挑战：空间和网络效应的相互作用、一般均衡中处理效应的演变，以及网络结构如何影响系统脆弱性。实证应用使用县级工资数据发现混合空间-网络效应占总处理传播的40%，一般均衡放大因子为1.8-2.5，基于熵的脆弱性指标能有效预测冲击传播。
AI.research_question: 如何分析通过空间邻近性和网络连接传播的处理效应？空间和网络效应如何相互作用？处理效应在一般均衡中如何演变？网络结构如何影响系统脆弱性？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于连续函数方法和纳维-斯托克斯基础，引入网络通道作为连续内部自由度，从守恒定律和随机过程的共同第一原理推导空间扩散和网络传染。

title: Outliers in CEO Compensation: The Case of Elon Musk’s 2018 Pay Package*
affiliations: Hanken School of Economics and University of Queensland

detail.title: Outliers in CEO Compensation: The Case of Elon Musk’s 2018 Pay Package*
detail.abstract: This paper investigates Elon Musk’s 2018 compensation to demonstrate that equity incentives serve as a control-enhancing mechanism that adds shareholder value rather than facilitating rent extraction. Our results support this argument: Tesla’s stock price responded positively to news approving Musk’s compensation and negatively to disapproval; Musk’s stock options are tied to stringent performance targets with restrictive exercise conditions; and exercises of his options are delayed. Given Musk’s investments in Tesla is firm-specific, granting stock options is a credible long-term contract to incentivize such investments by reducing shareholders’ temptation to appropriate rent from his investments.

title: Time-of-Day Effects in the Bitcoin Options Market
affiliations: The University of Western Australia

detail.title: Time-of-Day Effects in the Bitcoin Options Market
detail.abstract: Using a comprehensive dataset from Deribit, we show that Bitcoin options trading activity is concentrated around the 9th hour (8:00-9:00 GMT) and the 15th hour (14:00-15:00 GMT) relative to other hours of the day. The 15th hour peak aligns with the opening of the New York Stock Exchange and is largely absent on weekends, suggesting spillovers from traditional equity markets to the Bitcoin options market. In contrast, the 9th hour peak appears to be driven by investors rolling over and re-establishing expiring options around the 8:00 GMT settlement, as this effect persists on both weekdays and weekends, and is stronger on days with more expiring contracts and for contracts with shorter maturities. These findings highlight the interplay between cryptocurrency derivatives and traditional financial markets, and provide the first systematic evidence of intraday patterns in Bitcoin options trading.

title: Universal Basic Income (UBI)

detail.title: Universal Basic Income (UBI)
detail.abstract: The idea of Universal Basic Income (UBI) has been widely debated and tested by many governments lately as a new fiscal reform needed to reduce income inequality. The UBI can be defined as “a certain unconditional amount of cash transfers paid by the government to each citizen regardless of the marital, employment status, or any other preconditions”. The UBI substitutes all other social transfers financed by the government. Within this context, this study sheds light on adopted UBI schemes adopted in many countries to conclude policy recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析各国采用的全民基本收入（UBI）方案，旨在为减少收入不平等提供政策建议。UBI是无条件现金转移支付，替代其他政府资助的社会转移支付。

title: Advances and Challenges of Green Hydrogen in Chile: A Case Study of the National Strategy for Sustainable Energy Transition

detail.title: Advances and Challenges of Green Hydrogen in Chile: A Case Study of the National Strategy for Sustainable Energy Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest of any kind, whether financial, institutional, or personal, that could have influenced the preparation or content of this article. The research was conducted independently, with no involvement from funding bodies or stakeholders that could affect its objectivity.

detail.abstract:
Chile has positioned itself as one of the global frontrunners in the development of green hydrogen (GH₂) owing to its exceptional endowment of renewable resources and a pioneering national strategy launched in 2020. This article examines the advances and challenges of the Chilean experience as a case study of sustainable energy transition in Latin America.

Drawing on the official report Green Hydrogen – A National Project by the Chilean Ministry of Energy and complementary institutional sources, this study analyses the institutional, regulatory, technological and socioeconomic dimensions of the National Green Hydrogen Strategy (NGHS), as well as its implications for decarbonisation and productive diversification.

The findings reveal exponential growth in projects – from 20 in 2020 to over 70 in 2022 –alongside estimated investments of USD 45 billion by 2030 and potential annual export revenues exceeding USD 24 billion by 2050. However, challenges remain concerning the regulatory framework, infrastructure, cost competitiveness and coordination between public and private stakeholders.

It is concluded that Chile could become a global benchmark in the production of clean energy if it succeeds in consolidating an ecosystem of technological innovation, specialised human capital and participatory governance. The Chilean case offers valuable lessons for developing economies seeking to integrate green hydrogen as a pillar of their decarbonisation strategies.

title: The Imperative of Electing New York City's Inspector General: Fortifying Independence, Accountability, and Affordability in Municipal Oversight

detail.title: The Imperative of Electing New York City's Inspector General: Fortifying Independence, Accountability, and Affordability in Municipal Oversight
detail.abstract: This article examines the pivotal role of the New York City Department of Investigation (DOI) and its commissioner, commonly referred to as the Inspector General, in safeguarding civic integrity within one of the world's most complex urban environments. Through recent examples, including the politically charged removal of Commissioner Mark Peters and the indictment of Mayor Eric Adams, the article highlights the vulnerabilities inherent in the DOI's current structure, wherein mayoral appointment undermines its independence and exposes it to executive interference. Against a backdrop of municipal sprawl, systemic corruption, and escalating affordability challenges, including rising rents and widespread cost burdens, the analysis presents a compelling case for structural reform. Advocating for the election of the DOI commissioner, akin to borough district attorneys, the article argues that robust, independent oversight is essential to preventing corruption, safeguarding resources, and restoring public trust, thereby directly addressing economic and governance crises faced by contemporary New Yorkers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了纽约市调查局（DOI）及其专员在维护城市诚信中的关键作用，指出当前由市长任命专员的制度削弱了其独立性，容易受到行政干预。文章通过近期案例（如专员被免职和市长被起诉）说明结构脆弱性，主张通过选举专员来建立独立监督机制，以预防腐败、保护资源和重建公众信任。
AI.research_question: 纽约市调查局（DOI）的现行结构如何影响其独立性和有效性？选举专员是否能更好地保障公民诚信？
AI.motivation: 纽约市面临系统性腐败、市政扩张和日益严重的可负担性挑战，需要强有力的独立监督机构来保护公共资源和恢复公众信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政府监督和反腐败理论，强调独立监督机构在防止行政权力滥用和维护公共诚信中的重要性。
AI.method: 通过分析近期案例（如专员Mark Peters被免职和市长Eric Adams被起诉）来评估DOI结构的脆弱性。
AI.findings: 当前市长任命专员的制度削弱了DOI的独立性，使其容易受到行政干预，无法有效履行监督职能。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政府监督机构独立性理论提供了实证支持，强调了选举产生监督官员在保障机构独立性方面的重要性。

title: Strategic Planning and Structural Inertia in Azerbaijan's Post-Oil Economy: An Evaluation of the 2016-2025 National Roadmap
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Strategic Planning and Structural Inertia in Azerbaijan's Post-Oil Economy: An Evaluation of the 2016-2025 National Roadmap
detail.abstract: This paper provides an empirical assessment of Azerbaijan's Strategic Roadmap for the National Economy, adopted in 2016 with targets set through 2025. Drawing on official statistics and the author's own calculations, the study evaluates performance against four core objectives: (i) raising average annual real GDP growth above 3 percent; (ii) increasing the share of foreign direct investment (FDI) in non-oil GDP to 4 percent; (iii) boosting non-oil exports per capita from USD 170 to USD 450; and (iv) reducing the state budget's dependence on transfers from the State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan (SOFAZ) to 15 percent. The analysis shows that none of these targets have been met. Average annual GDP growth over 2016-2025 is estimated at 1.46 percent, well below the planned threshold. The share of FDI in non-oil GDP declined from 6.9 percent in 2016 to 0.7 percent in 2024, while per capita non-oil exports reached only about USD 330-more than 20 percent short of the 2025 target. At the same time, SOFAZ transfers still account for more than one-third of state budget revenues and are projected to remain structurally high. Labour-market indicators reveal additional fragility, with inflated job-creation figures, substantial job closures, and persistent reliance on publicsector employment. The findings point to a systematic implementation gap between strategic planning and actual outcomes, rooted in structural and institutional constraints rather than exogenous shocks alone. The paper concludes that without significant reforms in governance, investment climate, and statistical transparency, Azerbaijan's strategic planning exercises will continue to underperform as instruments of genuine diversification and structural transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文对阿塞拜疆2016年通过的《国民经济战略路线图》进行实证评估，发现截至2025年所有四个核心目标均未实现：GDP年均增长率仅1.46%（目标>3%）、非石油GDP中FDI占比降至0.7%（目标4%）、人均非石油出口仅330美元（目标450美元）、国家预算对石油基金转移支付依赖度仍超三分之一（目标15%）。研究指出战略规划与实施效果存在系统性差距，根源在于结构性制度约束。
AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆2016年通过的《国民经济战略路线图》在实现其四个核心目标方面的实际表现如何？
AI.motivation: 评估阿塞拜疆旨在实现经济多元化和结构转型的战略规划的实际效果，揭示战略目标与实际成果之间的差距及其根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略规划实施理论、经济多元化理论、制度约束理论
AI.method: 基于官方统计数据和作者自行计算的实证分析，评估2016-2025年期间四个核心目标的实现情况
AI.findings: 所有四个核心目标均未实现：GDP年均增长率1.46%（目标>3%）、FDI在非石油GDP中占比从6.9%降至0.7%（目标4%）、人均非石油出口仅330美元（目标450美元）、石油基金转移支付仍占预算收入超三分之一（目标15%）。劳动力市场指标显示就业数据虚高、大量工作岗位关闭、公共部门就业依赖持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了战略规划与实施效果之间的系统性差距，强调了结构性制度约束而非仅外生冲击是战略实施失败的根本原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿塞拜疆及其他资源依赖型经济体提供了重要政策启示：需要在治理、投资环境和统计透明度方面进行重大改革，否则战略规划将继续作为真正多元化和结构转型工具而表现不佳。

title: From Pitch to Progress: The Interplay of Team Reputation and Governance in Crowdfunded Innovation
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Finance, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: From Pitch to Progress: The Interplay of Team Reputation and Governance in Crowdfunded Innovation
detail.abstract: This study examines how team reputation affects both the funding success and the subsequent innovation progress in early-stage crowdfunded projects, with a comparative focus on blockchainbased and conventional crowdfunding platforms. Using development progress data for blockchain projects from the open-source platform GitHub, we find that while teams with stronger reputations raise more funds, their subsequent innovation productivity, measured by development activity, tends to lag. Further analysis reveals an association between higher team reputation and increased turnover of tokens post-fundraising, suggesting team members may strategically exercise exit options soon after securing financing. In contrast, analysis of Kickstarter campaigns reveals a more consistent alignment between team reputation, funding success, and project delivery. Specifically, highly reputable teams are more likely to meet not only their fundraising goal but also delivery commitments. We attribute this contrast to differences in platform governance; Kickstarter's structured oversight appears to mitigate early team disengagement and enhance project delivery compared to the blockchain context. These findings underscore the importance of effective governance mechanisms in crowdfunding platforms to ensure that team reputation signals translate into sustained innovation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 团队声誉在区块链众筹平台中虽然有助于获得更多资金，但会降低后续创新生产力；而在Kickstarter等传统平台中，声誉与资金成功和项目交付更一致。平台治理机制是造成这种差异的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 团队声誉如何影响早期众筹项目的资金成功和后续创新进展？区块链与传统众筹平台有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解团队声誉在不同众筹平台环境下的作用机制，特别是区块链平台中声誉与创新生产力之间的负向关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信号理论、团队声誉理论和平台治理理论，分析声誉在不同治理结构下的作用差异。
AI.method: 使用GitHub开发数据追踪区块链项目的创新生产力，分析Kickstarter项目交付情况，比较两种平台的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 高声誉团队在区块链平台获得更多资金但创新生产力下降；2. 区块链平台中高声誉团队代币周转率更高，表明早期退出倾向；3. Kickstarter高声誉团队更可能实现筹资目标和交付承诺；4. 平台治理机制是关键调节因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了声誉理论在数字平台环境下的应用，揭示了平台治理对声誉信号有效性的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为众筹平台设计治理机制提供指导，帮助投资者识别声誉信号的有效性，促进可持续创新。

title: Financial Analytics in Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACS) in Karnataka: Opportunities, Challenges, and Performance Insights
affiliations: Srinivas University and Srinivas University

detail.title: Financial Analytics in Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACS) in Karnataka: Opportunities, Challenges, and Performance Insights
detail.abstract: Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACS) represent the foundational layer of India's rural credit structure. In Karnataka, PACS play a vital role in facilitating shortterm credit, agricultural inputs, and rural financial services. However, many PACS face challenges related to inefficiency, non-performing assets (NPAs), and limited adoption of modern analytical practices. This study investigates how financial analytics can enhance operational efficiency, risk management, and profitability in PACS. The paper proposes a Financial Analytics Performance Framework (FAPF) that integrates financial indicators, data analytics tools, and performance evaluation metrics. Using empirical data from 120 PACS across Karnataka, regression, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and clustering techniques are applied to assess the impact of analytics adoption on financial performance. Results indicate that PACS with higher analytics maturity demonstrate better asset quality, profitability, and credit recovery rates. The findings provide policy recommendations for strengthening data-driven governance and sustainable cooperative finance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨金融分析如何提升印度卡纳塔克邦初级农业合作社(PACS)的运营效率、风险管理和盈利能力。通过构建金融分析绩效框架(FAPF)，基于120个PACS的实证数据，发现分析成熟度高的合作社在资产质量、盈利能力和信贷回收率方面表现更好。
AI.research_question: 金融分析如何增强初级农业合作社(PACS)的运营效率、风险管理和盈利能力？
AI.motivation: PACS作为印度农村信贷体系的基础层，面临效率低下、不良资产和现代分析实践应用有限等挑战，需要探索金融分析的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融分析绩效框架(FAPF)，整合金融指标、数据分析工具和绩效评估指标
AI.method: 基于120个PACS的实证数据，运用回归分析、主成分分析(PCA)和聚类技术
AI.findings: 分析成熟度高的PACS表现出更好的资产质量、盈利能力和信贷回收率

AI.practical_contributions: 为加强数据驱动治理和可持续合作金融提供政策建议

title: The Mobility Illusion: Diffuse Co-optation and Authoritarian Legitimacy in China
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Government & Public Administration and Renmin University of China - School of International Studies

detail.title: The Mobility Illusion: Diffuse Co-optation and Authoritarian Legitimacy in China
detail.abstract: How do authoritarian regimes maintain mass political support despite limited redistribution? We argue that beyond direct material benefits, the regime can harness citizens' perception of upward mobility to co-opt them in exchange for regime support. Drawing on a representative survey in China, we show that perceived upward mobility correlates with lower redistributive preferences and more positive evaluations of government performance, especially among those from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. Employing a regression discontinuity (RD) design based on the reinstatement of the National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao) in 1977, which serves as a main channel of social mobility in China, we further find only those exposed to signals of upward mobility exhibit more positive government evaluation and lower redistributive preferences, even in the absence of actual mobility experience and without receiving tangible material benefits. We develop an alternative form of co-optation, highlighting how mobility illusion fosters a more diffuse political support and acquiescence at minimal material cost in authoritarian regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，威权政权可以通过制造向上流动的感知来维持民众政治支持，即使没有实际物质再分配。在中国情境下，感知到的向上社会流动性与更低的再分配偏好和更积极的政府评价相关，特别是对低社会经济背景人群。
AI.research_question: 威权政权如何在有限的再分配情况下维持大众政治支持？
AI.motivation: 探讨威权政权除了直接物质利益外，如何利用公民对向上流动的感知来换取政权支持
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会流动感知与政治支持的关系理论；威权政权合作化机制；流动幻觉概念
AI.method: 使用中国代表性调查数据，并采用基于1977年高考恢复的断点回归设计(RD)
AI.findings: 感知向上流动性与更低的再分配偏好和更积极的政府评价相关；即使没有实际流动经历和物质利益，仅暴露于向上流动信号也会产生这些效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"流动幻觉"作为一种新的合作化形式，强调威权政权如何以最小物质成本培养政治支持和默许
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解威权韧性提供了新视角，揭示了社会流动感知在维持政权稳定中的重要作用

title: The Determinants of Short-Term Interest Rate Changes
affiliations: Solveva AG

detail.title: The Determinants of Short-Term Interest Rate Changes
detail.abstract: This study investigates the predictive power of the Fed funds futures market for shortterm U.S. Treasury rate changes. In light of the significant monetary policy adjustments by the Federal Reserve during and after the Covid-19 pandemic, this research shows how target rate factors derived from Fed funds futures market quotes can be used to model short-term rate changes. These factors track movements of the short-term rates that are accountable for the monetary policy adjustments and speculations related to such adjustments. By analyzing data from 2013 to 2023, the study finds that target rate factors can explain a large portion of short-term rate changes. Specifically, they account for 32% of the variance in 1-month rates, 78% in 3-month rates, and 89% in 6-month rates at a 10-day frequency, and 31%, 66%, and 81% respectively at a 5-day frequency. Additionally, the study discusses risk estimation during the volatile period of 2020-2022, emphasizing the importance of considering monetary policy related factors in risk analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明美联储基金期货市场的目标利率因子能够有效预测短期美国国债利率变化，在疫情期间及之后尤其显著，对1个月、3个月和6个月期利率变化的解释力分别达到32%、78%和89%。
AI.research_question: 美联储基金期货市场对短期美国国债利率变化的预测能力如何？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情期间及之后美联储的重大货币政策调整，需要研究如何利用美联储基金期货市场报价来建模短期利率变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美联储基金期货市场的目标利率因子理论，这些因子跟踪短期利率变动，反映货币政策调整及相关预期。
AI.method: 分析2013年至2023年的数据，使用目标利率因子建模短期利率变化，并在不同时间频率（5天和10天）下进行验证。
AI.findings: 目标利率因子对短期利率变化具有显著解释力：在10天频率下，对1个月、3个月和6个月期利率变化的方差解释率分别为32%、78%和89%；在5天频率下分别为31%、66%和81%。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了美联储基金期货市场作为货币政策预期指标的有效性，为短期利率预测提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理提供重要工具，特别是在2020-2022年波动期间，强调在风险分析中考虑货币政策相关因子的重要性。

title: Do Carbon Emissions Drain Corporate Cash Holdings? International Evidence
affiliations: Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) - Faculty of Accountancy, University of Wollongong in Dubai, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universitas Airlangga

detail.title: Do Carbon Emissions Drain Corporate Cash Holdings? International Evidence
detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between carbon emissions and corporate cash holdings using an international sample of 37,285 firm-year observations from 55 countries from 2010 to 2023. We employ fixed-effects regressions alongside alternative specifications that address endogeneity, heterogeneity, and potential mediation channels. We find that firms with higher overall carbon emissions maintain significantly lower cash levels, indicating reduced financial flexibility. This negative effect is mainly concentrated in Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, whereas Scope 3 emissions are positively associated with cash holdings, suggesting a distinct precautionary motive. Our channel analysis reveals that the adverse link between carbon emissions and cash holdings is primarily transmitted through high capital intensity and diminished growth opportunities. Furthermore, we document that this association is stronger in developed economies, civil law jurisdictions, prospector firms, low competition industries, and environmentally sensitive sectors. These findings establish that environmental performance, particularly its individual components, is an important yet complex determinant of liquidity policy, thereby extending the traditional drivers of corporate cash holdings.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于55个国家37,285个公司年度观测数据，发现碳排放与公司现金持有呈负相关，其中范围1和范围2排放降低现金持有，范围3排放增加现金持有，主要通过资本密集度和增长机会渠道传导。
AI.research_question: 碳排放与公司现金持有之间的关系是什么？不同范围排放的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 环境绩效对公司财务决策的影响日益重要，但碳排放对现金持有的影响机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、权衡理论和预防性动机理论，分析环境绩效对现金持有的影响。
AI.method: 使用固定效应回归和多种替代模型，处理内生性、异质性和中介渠道问题。
AI.findings: 总体碳排放与现金持有负相关；范围1和范围2排放降低现金持有，范围3排放增加现金持有；影响通过资本密集度和增长机会渠道传导；在发达经济体、大陆法系等情境下影响更强。

title: Optimal Climate and Monetary-Fiscal Policies in a Climate-DSGE Framework
affiliations: University of Padua and University of Ottawa - Department of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Climate and Monetary-Fiscal Policies in a Climate-DSGE Framework

keywords: Optimal environmental and fiscal and monetary policies

detail.abstract: This paper explores the optimal design of climate, fiscal, and monetary policies in response to climate-specific shocks within a climate-DSGE framework. We investigate the interaction between carbon taxation and fiscal-monetary policy under sticky prices, finding that traditional fiscal and monetary policies alone yield suboptimal outcomes in the presence of climate shocks. Our model demonstrates that carbon taxes significantly mitigate the adverse effects of these shocks on macroeconomic variables such as output, consumption, and welfare. We extend existing models by incorporating a climate-specific shock that impacts emissions, underscoring the necessity of carbon taxes to optimize welfare outcomes. Furthermore, we show that while optimal monetary policy is not significantly affected by climate policy, fiscal policy adjusts through lower labor income taxes, as the carbon tax generates additional revenue. Our findings suggest that to effectively address climate shocks, policy frameworks must integrate both macroeconomic and environmental considerations, highlighting the insufficiency of standalone fiscal-monetary approaches. We also examine the implications of climate fiscal outlays on optimal policy, showing that accounting for these outlays leads to higher optimal abatement and reduced emissions.

AI.tldr: 本文在气候-DSGE框架下研究气候冲击下的最优政策设计，发现碳税能显著缓解气候冲击对宏观经济的负面影响，而传统财政货币政策单独使用效果不佳。
AI.research_question: 在存在气候冲击的情况下，如何设计最优的气候、财政和货币政策？
AI.motivation: 传统财政和货币政策在应对气候冲击时效果不佳，需要整合宏观经济和环境考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候-DSGE框架，包含粘性价格和气候特定冲击。
AI.method: 构建包含气候冲击的DSGE模型，分析碳税与财政货币政策的互动。
AI.findings: 碳税能显著缓解气候冲击对产出、消费和福利的负面影响；最优货币政策不受气候政策显著影响；财政政策通过降低劳动所得税进行调整；考虑气候财政支出会提高最优减排水平和减少排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展现有模型，纳入影响排放的气候特定冲击；证明碳税在优化福利结果中的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供整合宏观经济和环境考量的政策框架；强调碳税在应对气候冲击中的关键作用。

title: What Does ETS Do to Real-Side Production Activity? Firm-Level Evidence from Korea
affiliations: Korea University

detail.title: What Does ETS Do to Real-Side Production Activity? Firm-Level Evidence from Korea
detail.abstract: This study examines the effects of Korea’s Emissions Trading Scheme (K-ETS) on real-side production activity in the manufacturing sector, using firm-level panel data constructed from Statistics Korea’s Mining and Manufacturing Survey and employing a Difference-in-Differences design. Covered firms showed no significant change in value added but experienced a temporary scale-down in production activity, with declines in both gross output and production costs during the first phase. Sectoral analysis reveals that the reduction was more prolonged in a few high-emission sectors. Covered firms also increased the share of electricity in their energy mix, mainly in the low-emission sector. No evidence of improved production efficiency was found, and employment also responded insignificantly to K-ETS across sectors. These findings suggest that firms’ real-side adjustments to K-ETS were temporary at the aggregate level but more sustained in certain sectors, accompanied by neither significant transition in the energy mix nor structural adjustment of production activity. This raises concerns about long-term industrial competitiveness and highlights the need for sector-specific policy measures.

AI.tldr: 韩国排放交易体系对制造业生产活动产生暂时性影响，高排放行业影响更持久，但未改善生产效率或能源结构转型。
AI.research_question: 韩国排放交易体系对制造业实际生产活动的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估排放交易体系对实体经济的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境规制理论、企业行为理论、排放交易机制理论
AI.method: 使用韩国统计厅矿业和制造业调查的企业层面面板数据，采用双重差分设计
AI.findings: 覆盖企业在第一阶段出现生产活动暂时缩减，高排放行业影响更持久；电力在能源结构中占比增加但主要在低排放行业；未发现生产效率改善；就业影响不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了环境规制对企业实际生产活动影响的理论认识，揭示了排放交易体系的异质性效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国排放交易体系政策优化提供实证依据，建议制定行业差异化政策，关注长期产业竞争力

title: Carbon Price Volatility Modeling: A STR-GARCH Approach Applied to the European Carbon Market
affiliations: Jean Lorougnon Guédé University and Jean Lorougnon Guédé University

detail.title: Carbon Price Volatility Modeling: A STR-GARCH Approach Applied to the European Carbon Market

keywords.keywords: Volatility - Carbon market - STR-GARCH-X - EU ETS - Energy transition - Exogenous variables.

detail.abstract: This study examines carbon price volatility in the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) using a Smooth Transition GARCH-X (STR-GARCH-X) model that incorporates energy, monetary, and climate variables. The daily dataset includes TTF natural gas prices, Brent crude oil prices, the EUR/USD exchange rate, and temperature anomalies, aggregated into a first principal component (PCA1) serving as the transition variable. Results identify two volatility regimes: a low-persistence regime during stable periods and a high-persistence regime marked by energy market shocks, monetary fluctuations, and climate-related stress. The high transition speed (γ = 2.775) indicates rapid switching once PCA1 crosses a threshold (c = −1.197). Positive and significant coefficients of exogenous variables in the variance equation confirm their amplifying effect. Compared with GARCH and GARCH-X models, STR-GARCH-X offers superior fit, highlighting the value of nonlinear approaches. Policy implications include proactive market stabilization, better coordination between climate and energy policies, and the use of climate forecasts in regulation. These results enhance understanding of ETS volatility drivers and support more effective energy transition policies in Europe.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用平滑转换GARCH-X模型分析欧盟碳排放交易体系价格波动，发现存在两种波动机制：稳定期的低持续性机制和能源市场冲击时的高持续性机制。模型显示外生变量对波动有放大效应，非线性方法优于传统GARCH模型。
AI.research_question: 欧盟碳排放交易体系价格波动如何受到能源、货币和气候变量的非线性影响？
AI.motivation: 理解碳排放交易体系价格波动机制对于制定有效的能源转型政策至关重要，现有线性模型可能无法捕捉复杂的非线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平滑转换自回归模型和GARCH-X模型，构建STR-GARCH-X模型来分析非线性波动机制。
AI.method: 使用STR-GARCH-X模型分析日度数据，包括天然气价格、原油价格、汇率和温度异常，通过主成分分析构建转换变量。
AI.findings: 识别出两种波动机制：低持续性稳定机制和高持续性冲击机制；转换速度快（γ=2.775）；外生变量显著放大波动；非线性模型拟合效果优于传统模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了碳排放交易体系波动建模的理论框架，证明了非线性方法的优越性，为理解复杂市场机制提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供市场稳定措施建议，强调气候与能源政策的协调，支持更有效的欧洲能源转型政策实施。

title: Changing Gears: The Welfare Impacts of Brand Ideology
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Changing Gears: The Welfare Impacts of Brand Ideology
detail.abstract: We examine the extent to which ideology influences consumer willingness-to-pay (WTP) for an environmental good and, consequently, private and social welfare. Using Texas vehicle registrations, we estimate that WTP for the Tesla brand falls by $12,000 among Democrat ZIPs and moderate ZIPs from 2021Q1 through 2025Q1. We show that the steepest falls in WTP for Teslas correspond to CEO Elon Musk's Republican political involvement. We observe a particularly sharp fall in WTP for Teslas of $8,000 during Musk's involvement in the 2024 election. Consequently, we estimate that Musk's 2024 election involvement leads Tesla revenues to fall $2.3 billion per year in the U.S.A. Democrat and moderate consumers substituted primarily to gas vehicles, leading annual damages from vehicular carbon emissions to rise by $32 million and private surplus to fall by $1.6 billion per year. Our findings highlight that ideology drives consumption of environmental goods, which may inhibit private and social welfare.

AI.tldr: 研究发现意识形态显著影响消费者对环保产品的支付意愿，特斯拉品牌价值在民主党选民区域下降12,000美元，主要与马斯克参与共和党政治活动相关，导致特斯拉年收入减少23亿美元，消费者转向燃油车造成碳排放增加和私人福利下降。
AI.research_question: 意识形态如何影响消费者对环境产品的支付意愿，进而影响私人和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 理解政治意识形态对环保产品消费行为的影响，以及这种影响对经济福利和环境后果的启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于意识形态驱动的消费行为理论，探讨政治立场如何影响消费者对环保品牌的价值评估和购买决策。
AI.method: 使用德克萨斯州车辆注册数据，分析不同政治倾向区域对特斯拉品牌的支付意愿变化，特别关注马斯克政治参与期间的变化。
AI.findings: 民主党区域对特斯拉支付意愿下降12,000美元，马斯克参与2024年大选期间下降8,000美元，导致特斯拉年收入减少23亿美元，消费者转向燃油车增加碳排放3,200万美元，私人福利减少16亿美元。

title: Regulating the Unregulated: Governance Models for Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) in Financial Markets
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics

detail.title: Regulating the Unregulated: Governance Models for Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) in Financial Markets
detail.abstract: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) have emerged as the de facto governance layer for major decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols and real-world asset (RWA) tokenization platforms, yet they operate in a profound legal and regulatory vacuum. Unlike traditional financial entities, DAOs lack formal legal personality, fiduciary duties, or mechanisms for regulatory accountability, despite managing assets estimated at $25 billion globally as of 2024. This research examines how DAOs are transforming financial governance and identifies the necessary regulatory adjustments to ensure investor protection, market integrity, and systemic resilience without compromising the core innovation of decentralized coordination. Through a mixedmethods approach-including governance mapping of 30+ financial DAOs, comparative legal analysis of emerging regulatory responses (from the EU's MiCA framework to Wyoming's DAO LLC statute), and semi-structured interviews with developers, regulators, and institutional participants-the study proposes a novel "functional equivalence" model for DAO regulation. This model grants legal recognition to DAOs when they engage in regulated financial activities, while preserving code-based autonomy in non-regulated functions. The research offers a pragmatic pathway toward aligning decentralized innovation with public accountability, filling a critical gap in both academic literature and policy design.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种"功能等价"监管模型，为从事受监管金融活动的DAO提供法律认可，同时保留非监管功能中的代码自治，旨在协调去中心化创新与公共问责。
AI.research_question: DAO如何改变金融治理？需要哪些监管调整来确保投资者保护、市场完整性和系统韧性，同时不损害去中心化协调的核心创新？
AI.motivation: DAO作为主要DeFi协议和RWA代币化平台的事实治理层，在深刻的法律和监管真空中运作，缺乏正式法律人格、信托责任或监管问责机制，但管理着约250亿美元的全球资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能等价模型、去中心化治理理论、金融监管理论
AI.method: 混合方法：包括30多个金融DAO的治理映射、新兴监管响应的比较法律分析（从欧盟MiCA框架到怀俄明州DAO LLC法规）、与开发者、监管者和机构参与者的半结构化访谈
AI.findings: 提出了"功能等价"监管模型，当DAO从事受监管金融活动时授予法律认可，同时在非监管功能中保留基于代码的自治
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了学术文献中的关键空白，提出了协调去中心化创新与公共问责的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策设计提供了务实路径，提供了确保投资者保护、市场完整性和系统韧性的监管解决方案

title: Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimators
affiliations: Boston College

detail.title: Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimators
detail.abstract: Regression analysis remains a cornerstone of empirical research. Most existing approaches are based on least squares which can be quite sensitive to outliers if the data distribution is far from Gaussianity. This paper proposes "Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimators" (DARE), a framework designed to enhance both robustness and efficiency, particularly in settings where classical least squares methods exhibit poor performance. DARE efficiently aggregates distributional information through a weighted aggregation of quantiles, improving robustness to the unknown distribution of error terms. Under suitable regularity conditions, DARE achieves the same asymptotic variance as the infeasible likelihood-based methods while maintaining the same convergence rate as conventional estimators. A wide range of regression models are investigated. I establish asymptotic properties under both series and local linear frameworks. In addition, I develop machine learning implementations based on random forests that preserve asymptotic validity, and incorporate high-dimensional linear settings via LASSO to obtain efficient estimators for the nonzero coefficients. Extensive simulations demonstrate substantial finite-sample improvements. Finally, I apply DARE in two empirical analyses of treatment effects. In both cases, DARE produces point estimates comparable to conventional methods while delivering notably tighter confidence intervals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"分布自适应回归估计器"(DARE)框架，通过加权聚合分位数来增强回归分析的稳健性和效率，特别是在数据分布远离高斯分布时。DARE在保持与传统估计器相同收敛速度的同时，达到了与不可行似然方法相同的渐近方差。
AI.research_question: 如何在回归分析中开发一个既能增强稳健性又能提高效率的框架，特别是在数据分布远离高斯分布的情况下？
AI.motivation: 传统最小二乘法在数据分布远离高斯分布时对异常值非常敏感，现有方法在稳健性和效率之间存在权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布自适应回归估计器(DARE)框架，基于分位数的加权聚合来利用分布信息。
AI.method: 开发了基于随机森林的机器学习实现，并整合了LASSO来处理高维线性设置，研究了多种回归模型，包括序列和局部线性框架。
AI.findings: DARE在有限样本中表现出显著改进，在实证分析中产生与传统方法相当的点估计，但置信区间明显更紧。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了DARE在序列和局部线性框架下的渐近性质，证明其能达到与不可行似然方法相同的渐近方差。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实际应用的稳健回归方法，在治疗效应等实证分析中展现出优越的统计效率。

title: Parody Defendants are Finding Success Post-Jack Daniel's
affiliations: University of Houston Law Center

detail.title: Parody Defendants are Finding Success Post-Jack Daniel's
detail.abstract: The Supreme Court's 2023 decision in Jack Daniel's v. VIP Products was widely perceived to be a win for trademark owners and a loss for parodists, but recent cases cast some doubt on this assessment.  Although the decision did significantly limit defendants' ability to escape the likelihood of confusion inquiry through the First Amendment Rogers defense for expressive trademark uses, it also encouraged courts to more fully consider any parodic aspects of the defendant's use within the likelihood of confusion analysis itself. Some courts have been taking heed of this suggestion, hesitating to find likelihood of confusion where the allegedly infringing work has an arguably parodic character.

AI.tldr: 2023年杰克丹尼诉VIP产品案虽然限制了被告通过第一修正案罗杰斯抗辩来规避混淆可能性调查的能力，但也鼓励法院在混淆可能性分析中更充分地考虑被告使用的戏仿性质。
AI.research_question: 2023年杰克丹尼诉VIP产品案对商标侵权案件中戏仿抗辩的实际影响是什么？

AI.theoretical_framework: 商标侵权法、第一修正案罗杰斯抗辩、戏仿理论、混淆可能性分析
AI.method: 案例分析法，研究最高法院判决及其在后续案件中的应用

title: Environmental regulation informed by biased stakeholders
affiliations: University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics and Aarhus University

detail.title: Environmental regulation informed by biased stakeholders
detail.abstract: Public consultations are widely used in regulatory processes, allowing stakeholders to present their viewpoints despite their inherent biases. Some stakeholders, such as firms, are known to be pro-business, while others, such as environmental NGOs, are pro-environment. We develop a framework to analyze how a regulator processes information provided by biased stakeholders. We distinguish between stakeholders whose biases are high and known and those whose biases are small but unknown, such as national authorities. We show that the regulator follows the advice that runs counter to a stakeholder's typical bias, i.e., to regulate if firms so advise, and not to regulate if environmental organizations so advise. Without such advice, she prioritizes the comments provided by stakeholders with smaller but unknown bias. Next, we contrast our theoretical results with the regulation of chemicals in the European Union. In line with our theory, we find that support for regulation has a strong and significant impact on the decision to regulate when the support comes from firms but not when it comes from NGOs and environmental agencies. We also find that national authorities have a stronger influence than other stakeholders in the regulation decision, both by the number of comments and the relative support.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个分析监管者如何处理有偏见利益相关者信息的框架。研究发现监管者会采纳与利益相关者典型偏见相反的建议，并优先考虑偏见较小但未知的利益相关者。欧盟化学品监管的实证结果支持了理论预测。
AI.research_question: 监管者如何处理有偏见的利益相关者在公共咨询中提供的信息？
AI.motivation: 公共咨询在监管过程中被广泛使用，但利益相关者存在固有偏见，需要理解监管者如何有效处理这些有偏见的信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理框架，区分高已知偏见利益相关者（如企业、环保NGO）和小未知偏见利益相关者（如国家当局）
AI.method: 理论模型开发和欧盟化学品监管的实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 监管者采纳与利益相关者典型偏见相反的建议；2. 优先考虑偏见较小但未知的利益相关者；3. 企业支持监管对监管决策有显著影响，而NGO支持无显著影响；4. 国家当局在监管决策中影响力最强
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了分析有偏见利益相关者信息处理的理论框架，揭示了监管者的逆向推理决策模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构在公共咨询中有效筛选和处理利益相关者信息提供了实践指导

title: Watts to Wealth: Electricity, Efficiency, and Industrial Asset Pricing
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Watts to Wealth: Electricity, Efficiency, and Industrial Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: I develop a production-based asset-pricing framework that puts electricity at the center of return formation. A dual-output technology motivated by the SIDO framework, underpins the two price-orthogonalised predictors: a scale signal (ΔEC) and an efficiency residual (EE(net)). Using year-over-year (YoY) panels for Italy and Sweden across key industrial sectors, I select forecasting lags by BIC and include fixed effects.At the annual horizon, signals are clearest, but they diverge across countries. ΔEC (net of prices) forecasts returns with conflicting signs: while positive in one pooled and sectoral models (1/3 sectors) in Italy (rewarding activity), the signal is statistically insignificant in pooled Sweden. Conversely, EE(net) is small, negative, and statistically insignificant in pooled Sweden, yet small or mixed in Italy. Price terms are influential; EU ETS allowances price loads negatively in Italy, while forward energy is insignificant in Sweden. Fit is respectable in pooled panels (R2 up to ≈ 0.41). A firm-level case study on Italian foundries confirms this mechanism: the usage proxy (FU) is a marginally significant positive YoY predictor (coefficient ≈ +0.37 to +0.43 at k=1), confirming scale leads predictability. Robustness to excess-return definitions (EURIBOR/STIBOR) is crucial: it shows the Italian ΔEC signal is robust and significant in one spec, while the Swedish predictability is structurally robust (with a negative ΔEC) and anchored by price risk.Overall, energy scale and efficiency surprises are reliably priced at annual horizons, but the predictive mechanism is profoundly dependent on the specific country's operational economics, offering a transparent template for energy-anchored return tests.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个以电力为核心的生产型资产定价框架，通过双产出技术生成两个价格正交化的预测因子：规模信号(ΔEC)和效率残差(EE(net))。研究发现能源规模和效率意外在年度层面可靠地影响资产回报，但预测机制高度依赖特定国家的运营经济特征。
AI.research_question: 电力相关的规模信号和效率信号如何预测资产回报？这些预测机制在不同国家间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 将电力置于回报形成的中心位置，为能源锚定的回报测试提供透明模板
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于SIDO框架的生产型资产定价理论，双产出技术生成价格正交化预测因子
AI.method: 使用意大利和瑞典的年度面板数据，通过BIC选择预测滞后，包含固定效应，进行企业级案例研究
AI.findings: ΔEC在意大利正向预测回报（奖励活动），在瑞典统计不显著；EE(net)在两国均较小或不显著；价格项影响显著，EU ETS价格在意大利负向加载
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以电力为中心的生产型资产定价框架，揭示了能源规模和效率信号在回报形成中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于能源运营特征的资产回报预测工具，强调了国别差异的重要性

title: Valuing Environmental Externalities under Risk: Evidence from a Lab-in-the-Field Experiment
affiliations: Université Montpellier I, Université Montpellier I, Université Montpellier I and University of Montpellier

detail.title: Valuing Environmental Externalities under Risk: Evidence from a Lab-in-the-Field Experiment
detail.abstract: We experimentally examine the behavioral foundations of green investing by testing the Gasser et al. (2017) extension of Markowitz (1952), which adds an environmental externality to the mean–variance utility function. Understanding how investors trade off financial and environmental objectives is central to the efficiency of modern financial markets, as capital allocation increasingly shapes environmental and social outcomes.Using a lab-in-the-field experiment with 66 finance professionals and a student replication (N = 103), participants allocated portfolios among assets differing in risk, return, and environmental externalities. The externality is implemented through delegated philanthropy—a donation from the experimenter to a reforestation NGO when investing in a green asset—and delegated misanthropy, a symmetric donation to a fossil-fuel organization when investing in a brown asset. This design creates real pecuniary externalities and isolates the trade-off between return and environmental impact in an incentive-compatible setting.We first confirm risk–impact separability: risk assessments and return correlations are unaffected by the asset’s environmental “color.” Yet preferences are non-linear—marginal utility decreases with exposure, and aversion to brown assets dominates attraction to green ones. These patterns generate incomplete diversification and systematic deviations from mean–variance optimization.We further document a robust return–impact trade-off: investors accept lower returns for green assets and to avoid brown ones, but the penalty for brown assets is stronger than the reward for green ones. Finance professionals show more stable and consistent preferences than students. Overall, sustainable motives are separable but non-linear, driven more by harm aversion than by pro-environmental enthusiasm.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验检验绿色投资的行为基础，发现投资者在财务回报和环境目标之间存在非线性权衡：对棕色资产的厌恶强于对绿色资产的偏好，且边际效用随风险敞口递减，导致投资组合分散不足。
AI.research_question: 投资者如何在财务回报和环境目标之间进行权衡？绿色投资的行为基础是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解投资者在财务和环境目标间的权衡对现代金融市场效率至关重要，因为资本配置日益影响环境和社会结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gasser等人(2017)对Markowitz(1952)均值-方差效用函数的扩展，加入了环境外部性。
AI.method: 采用实地实验室实验，66名金融专业人士参与，学生复制样本(N=103)。通过委托慈善(投资绿色资产时向环保组织捐款)和委托厌恶(投资棕色资产时向化石燃料组织捐款)实现真实外部性。
AI.findings: 1)风险-影响可分离性成立；2)偏好非线性，边际效用随风险敞口递减；3)对棕色资产的厌恶强于对绿色资产的偏好；4)导致投资组合分散不足；5)金融专业人士比学生表现出更稳定一致的偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可持续投资偏好的非线性特征，证明环境动机更多由伤害规避而非亲环境热情驱动。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解可持续投资行为提供了实证基础，有助于设计更有效的绿色金融产品和政策。

title: Collusion Through Gender Lens: Insights from Brazil's Cartel Cases
affiliations: and SciencesPo - Sciences po Paris Law School

detail.title: Collusion Through Gender Lens: Insights from Brazil's Cartel Cases
detail.abstract: This paper explores cartel behavior through a gender lens using a unique dataset of 135 cartel cases sanctioned by the Brazilian Competition Authority (CADE) between 1999 and 2024, involving 1,129 convicted individuals. The findings reveal a significant gender imbalance: 93% of cartelists were men and only 7% were women, typically occupying non-managerial roles. Also, women were less involved in trade association cartels, suggesting that male-dominated “boys’ club” networks may underpin trust and collusive stability. In terms of duration, cartels with more gender-balanced participation lasted on average 1.4 years, compared to 5.8 years for male-dominated ones. These results highlight how gender dynamics can shape cartel formation and duration, providing new insights for competition policy and enforcement. The use of a gender lens, as advocated by the OECD Gender Inclusive Competition Toolkit (2023), can enhance understanding of collusion and inform more inclusive competition policy strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过性别视角分析巴西135个卡特尔案件，发现93%的卡特尔成员为男性，女性仅占7%且多担任非管理职位。性别平衡的卡特尔平均持续1.4年，而男性主导的卡特尔持续5.8年，表明性别动态影响卡特尔的形成和稳定性。
AI.research_question: 性别如何影响卡特尔的形成、结构和持续时间？
AI.motivation: 现有卡特尔研究缺乏性别视角，而性别动态可能影响信任建立和合谋稳定性，这为理解卡特尔行为提供了新的分析维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别与网络理论、社会资本理论、"男孩俱乐部"网络概念
AI.method: 使用巴西竞争管理局1999-2024年间135个卡特尔案件的独特数据集，涉及1,129名被定罪个人
AI.findings: 1) 卡特尔成员中93%为男性，7%为女性；2) 女性多担任非管理职位；3) 女性较少参与行业协会卡特尔；4) 性别平衡的卡特尔平均持续1.4年，男性主导的卡特尔持续5.8年
AI.theory_contributions: 将性别视角引入卡特尔研究，揭示性别动态如何通过"男孩俱乐部"网络影响合谋稳定性和持续时间
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争政策制定者提供基于性别分析的执法策略，支持OECD性别包容竞争工具包的实施

title: Common ownership and environmental corporate social responsibility in a vertically related market
affiliations: Guangzhou College of Commerce and Chonnam National University

detail.title: Common ownership and environmental corporate social responsibility in a vertically related market
detail.abstract: This study considers a vertically related market where an upstream firm supplies an intermediate good to competing downstream firms that adopt environmental corporate social responsibility (ECSR) through green managerial delegation contracts, guided by their common ownership incentives. We find that downstream firms may engage in ECSR, which involves costly investment in pollution abatement, that can reduce intermediate prices and thus, the collusive effect of common ownership may increase market competition through ECSR. We examine market competition mode and show that Cournot firms adopt ECSR only when common ownership is sufficiently high or product substitutability is sufficiently low, whereas Bertrand firms always adopt ECSR. Furthermore, Cournot competition can yield higher welfare than Bertrand competition when the degree of common ownership is sufficiently high (low) and product substitutability is sufficiently low (high). As environmental damage increases, Cournot competition yields much higher welfare than Bertrand competition. Finally, we compare outcomes under discriminatory input prices and mandatory ECSR guidelines, and discuss the policy implications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究垂直相关市场中，上游企业向采用环境企业社会责任(ECSR)的下游竞争企业供应中间产品的情况。研究发现，ECSR可能降低中间价格，共同所有权通过ECSR可能增加市场竞争。Cournot竞争下企业仅在共同所有权较高或产品替代性较低时采用ECSR，而Bertrand竞争下企业总是采用ECSR。环境损害增加时，Cournot竞争产生更高福利。
AI.research_question: 在垂直相关市场中，下游企业采用环境企业社会责任(ECSR)如何影响市场竞争模式、福利结果和政策含义？
AI.motivation: 研究共同所有权激励下，企业通过绿色管理委托合同采用ECSR对市场竞争和福利的影响，探讨不同竞争模式下的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直相关市场理论、环境企业社会责任(ECSR)、共同所有权理论、Cournot和Bertrand竞争模型、绿色管理委托合同
AI.method: 理论模型分析，比较Cournot和Bertrand竞争模式下企业ECSR采用决策、市场价格、福利效应
AI.findings: 1. ECSR可能降低中间价格，共同所有权通过ECSR增加市场竞争；2. Cournot企业仅在共同所有权高或产品替代性低时采用ECSR，Bertrand企业总是采用ECSR；3. 特定条件下Cournot竞争产生更高福利；4. 环境损害增加时Cournot竞争福利优势更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了共同所有权与ESCR关系的理论理解；2. 揭示了不同竞争模式下ESCR采用动机的差异；3. 丰富了垂直市场结构下环境规制与企业战略互动的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计ESCR指南提供理论依据；2. 帮助企业理解在不同市场结构下采用ESCR的战略意义；3. 为反垄断机构评估共同所有权与ESCR的竞争效应提供参考
